title: A Work Day in Japan — Easy Japanese Listening for Beginners / 日本人の仕事の一日
description: A beginner-friendly listening comprehension exercise narrating a typical Japanese office worker's day. Covers morning meetings (朝礼), convenience-store breakfast routine, office hierarchy and interactions with colleagues (同僚), and concludes with a nomikai (飲み会 — after-work drinking party) where Japanese workers socialize outside the office. Designed for JLPT N5-N4 learners with clear narration, on-screen Japanese text, and context clues from visual storytelling.
creator: Easy Japanese Listening channel
